summary: Intermittent connection issues while configuring services
description: A merchant is unable to log in to the Customer UI to review and e-sign the Merchant Agreement due to login credentials not being accepted.
resolution: Identified a database inconsistency causing the false error message. Resolved the issue by correcting the location mapping in the database, allowing the Sales Agent to proceed with adding the new location.
